relationships.subject: DNA methylation
relationships.evidence_quote: Six differentially methylated regions were significantly ( P < 5 × 10 -8 ) associated with chronic painful TMD

relationships.subject: DNA methylation
relationships.evidence_quote: Co-regulation between the respective DMR CpGs and the nearest gene was strong in most or all subgroups for cg07533224 (with PM20D1) and cg15570656 (with ZFP57) indicating a tight inverse relationship between methylation and expression of the expected, most proximal gene.

key_findings: Six DMRs near FMOD, PM20D1, ZNF718, ZFP57/MOG, RNF39 and TRAF2 associate with chronic painful TMD in blood.
Methylation at these loci tracks with nearby SNPs (mQTLs) and gene expression, and changes between acute onset and 6-month follow-up.
